100k is one stress pair. No leak conclusion from its Private Bytes or Working Set.
Application viewing follows last activated analysis window and current top tab; does not inspect screen occlusion or user gaze.
Earlier repeated-Wafer fixture had zero valid Maps. Earlier numeric-ready timings did not establish Trend canvas visibility; neither replaces these runs.
second_full_reason: Initial full found two real regressions also reproducible in frozen v4.3.3. Both received red/green local fixes before the final full; no repeat fishing for performance green.
assertion_scope: Raw/child string frames and Undo are exact; target curve arrays use numpy array equality; summary DataFrames use pandas default floating tolerance; final five plot digests compare canonical float64 data with normalized NaNs. The benchmark field exact_assertions_passed is qualified by this scope.
